name: SUPRA Mission Center
description: Central orchestration hub enforcing single-writer rule. All mutations pass through SUPRA-Builder.

roles.name: Executive
roles.description: Receives the mission, decides strategy, produces high-level plan

roles.name: Planner
roles.description: Decomposes mission into sub-missions, creates execution plan

roles.name: Router
roles.description: Selects agents, providers, and models for each sub-mission

roles.name: Explorer
roles.description: Navigates codebase, maps structure, gathers context

roles.name: Auditor
roles.description: Analyzes code, checks compliance, verifies integrity

roles.name: Benchmark
roles.description: Benchmarks models and agents for performance

roles.name: Comparator
roles.description: Compares results from parallel read agents

roles.name: Fusion
roles.description: Merges analyses, resolves conflicts, produces unified output

roles.name: Validator
roles.description: Validates coherence and consistency of final output

roles.name: Builder
roles.description: EXCLUSIVE write agent. Applies mutations, creates files, modifies code.

access_control.rule: Only SUPRA-Builder may create, modify, or delete files. All other agents are strictly read-only.
access_control.violation_action: Block and log. Route mutation request through Mission Center to SUPRA-Builder.
